title: S-Agent 2.0: Spatial Reasoning with a General Coding Agent
title_zh: S-Agent 2.0：用通用编码代理实现空间推理

paragraphs.en: S-Agent 2.0为通用编码代理配备命令行感知工具包，通过场景记忆与空间语言解释弥合模型与工具间的鸿沟，显著提升空间推理能力。 Spatial reasoning asks a model to work out where objects are in 3D space, how they relate to one another, and how they move. Agentic VLMs have recently brought large improvements on such tasks by letting the model actively gather evidence with 3D perception tools instead of answering in a single pass. Even so, on many questions the tools return the right evidence and the model still does not arrive at the correct answer: the gap between model and tools, where raw readings become usable conclusions, is left unfilled. We present S-Agent 2.0, a spatial reasoning agent that equips an off-the-shelf general coding agent with a command-line perception toolkit, and we design the interface around one principle: help the VLM close the evidence loop: acquire scene evidence, remember it in a persistent scene memory, and interpret each reading in plain spatial language. This design keeps the full flexibility of a coding agent, and every reading it acts on stays grounded in the tools' geometry. On MMSI-Bench and ReVSI, the toolkit improves a strong open-source model, Qwen3.8-27B, by +13.9 and +20.5 points over the same agent without tools, and a strong closed-source model, Gemini-3.8-Flash, by +11.2 and +9.6 points. With the open backbone S-Agent 2.0 reaches 66.5 on MMSI-Bench and 82.3 on ReVSI, ahead of the specialized system SpatialClaw on the same backbone (62.6 and 74.5), and with Gemini-3.8-Flash it reaches 74.1 and 90.5 against its 67.0 and 79.7. Both tool gains shrink as the backbone grows more capable, but SpatialClaw's shrinks far more on ReVSI, from +13.2 to +2.7, while ours stays at +9.6. S-Agent 2.0 also works across different general coding agent harnesses, such as Codex and Claude Code.
paragraphs.zh: S-Agent 2.0 为通用编码智能体配备命令行感知工具包，通过场景记忆与空间语言解释弥合模型与工具间的鸿沟，显著提升空间推理能力。空间推理要求模型推算物体在三维空间中的位置、它们之间的关系以及它们的运动方式。 智能体化的视觉语言模型（VLM）最近在这类任务上带来了大幅提升，方法是让模型主动借助三维感知工具收集证据，而不是一次性直接作答。 即便如此，在许多问题上，工具返回了正确的证据，模型却仍未得出正确答案：从原始读数变为可用结论的模型与工具之间的鸿沟依然没有被填补。 我们提出 S-Agent 2.0，这是一个空间推理智能体，它为现成的通用编码智能体配备命令行感知工具包，并围绕一条原则设计接口：帮助 VLM 闭环证据链——获取场景证据、将其存入持久的场景记忆中、并用通俗的空间语言解释每条读数。 这一设计保留了编码智能体的完全灵活性，同时智能体所依据的每条读数都始终扎根于工具的几何信息。 在 MMSI-Bench 和 ReVSI 上，该工具包使强大的开源模型 Qwen3.8-27B 相比无工具的同一智能体分别提升 +13.9 和 +20.5 分，使强大的闭源模型 Gemini-3.8-Flash 分别提升 +11.2 和 +9.6 分。 借助开源骨干模型，S-Agent 2.0 在 MMSI-Bench 上达到 66.5 分，在 ReVSI 上达到 82.3 分，领先于相同骨干模型上的专用系统 SpatialClaw（62.6 和 74.5）；配合 Gemini-3.8-Flash 则达到 74.1 和 90.5 分，而后者为 67.0 和 79.7 分。 随着骨干模型能力增强，两种工具的增益都在缩小，但在 ReVSI 上 SpatialClaw 的增益缩水幅度远大于我们：从 +13.2 降至 +2.7，而我们的仍保持在 +9.6。 S-Agent 2.0 还能跨不同的通用编码智能体框架运行，例如 Codex 和 Claude Code。
